summary_en: Post-adjustment settlement for commitment-type buyback (FCSR) tranches 1 & 2: 2,414,783 shares acquired per tranche via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-05-13; average prices ¥23,979.08 (period 1) and ¥23,972.34 (period 2) calculated from 2026-05-14 to 2026-08-05 TSE VWAP with adjustments; tranche 1 saw 13,100 share increase, tranche 2 saw 13,800 share increase via free acquisition from warrant holders.
title_en: Notification of Post-Adjustment Results in Commitment-Type Share Buyback (FCSR)
translation_en_brief: Daikin Industries announced on 2026-08-06 the finalization of post-adjustment results for adjustment periods 1 and 2 of its commitment-type share buyback (FCSR) program, originally disclosed on 2026-05-12. Under this program, Daikin acquires its own shares via ToSTNeT-3 with a broker (Nomura Securities), and the purchase amount is divided into six adjustment periods. The average purchase price for each tranche is recalculated post-execution based on the arithmetic mean of the TSE volume-weighted average price (VWAP) from 2026-05-14 through 2026-08-05, adjusted by discount factors (99.575% for period 1, 99.547% for period 2). For both periods 1 and 2, Daikin acquired 2,414,783 shares on the execution date 2026-05-13. The post-adjustment process determined average prices of ¥23,979.08 (period 1) and ¥23,972.34 (period 2). In each period, the number of shares that would have been acquired at the calculated average price exceeded the actual acquired amount, triggering an increase adjustment of 13,100 shares (period 1) and 13,800 shares (period 2), which Daikin will acquire free of charge from warrant holders to compensate for the price difference.
